blocks.text: Hypotheses are classified into different types. Each type has a specific purpose. The most common types are null and alternative hypotheses. These types work together in testing. Correct hypotheses improve analysis quality by reducing confusion. They guide decision-making. Understanding hypothesis types is important. They form the base of hypothesis testing.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Students write a null and alternative hypothesis for marks or percentage situation. Discuss correctness.
